statements.subject: state_machine
statements.description: ConnectRetryTime is a mandatory FSM attribute that stores the initial value for the ConnectRetryTimer. The suggested default value for the ConnectRetryTime is 120 seconds.

statements.subject: state_machine
statements.description: HoldTime is a mandatory FSM attribute that stores the initial value for the HoldTimer. The suggested default value for the HoldTime is 90 seconds.

statements.subject: state_machine
statements.description: The KeepaliveTime is a mandatory FSM attribute that stores the initial value for the KeepaliveTimer. The suggested default value for the KeepaliveTime is 1/3 of the HoldTime.

statements.subject: timer
statements.description: BGP employs five timers: ConnectRetryTimer, HoldTimer, KeepaliveTimer, MinASOriginationIntervalTimer, and MinRouteAdvertisementIntervalTimer.
